instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Montserrat' font for the entire application. Add the Google Font link to public/index.html.
Ensure the Sidebar is collapsible and persists state.
The Dashboard must feature a 'Bento' style grid layout (Mode B from guidelines).
For Charts: Use Pie Charts for 'Sectors' and 'Member Packages'. Use Bar Charts for 'Events' and 'Financials'.
Login Page: Simple centered card with Logo, Email, Password. Background can be a subtle #F8FAFC or a split screen with the Event image.
All text must be in Azerbaijani as per requirements.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, sidebar links).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use Bento grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
